title: Practising the card game before it matters
target: How to learn the card game inside TCG Card Shop Simulator using the rulebook, the mulligan and the screens the game provides, rather than learning it by losing.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)

steps.do: Read the rulebook before your first game rather than after a loss.
steps.because: the game ships a rulebook screen of its own (PlayCardRulebookScreen)

steps.do: Treat the mulligan as a real decision rather than a formality.
steps.because: a game opens with a mulligan screen (PlayCardSetUIScreen_Mulligan)

steps.do: Watch the action resolution instead of skipping past it.
steps.because: actions resolve on a screen of their own (PlayCardSetUIScreen_ActionResolve)
picking an element area is its own step (PlayCardSetUIScreen_SelectElementArea)

steps.do: Inspect the board whenever you are unsure what is in play.
steps.because: there is a screen for inspecting the board (PlayCardSetUIScreen_InspectBoard)

commonMistakes: Clicking through the mulligan without thinking.
Assuming the board is what you remember it to be.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
